title: Longest Word (Borrowed Slice)
prompt:
Write a function longest_word that takes a string slice and returns a slice of the SAME input pointing at its longest word. Words are separated by whitespace. If several words tie for longest, return the first one. If the input has no words, return an empty string slice.

The point of the exercise: return a &str that borrows from the input instead of allocating a new String.

Example:
  longest_word("the quick brownish fox") -> "brownish"
  longest_word("ab cd") -> "ab"
  longest_word("   ") -> ""
